commits.author: Akhil CH
commits.message:
Add a PauseHandler for Eureka clients

Calling /actuator/pause now sets the instance status to OUT_OF_SERVICE
in Eureka, and /actuator/resume cancels that override. The handler is
only created when spring-cloud-context is on the classpath, auto
registration is enabled and the instance registers with Eureka.

Fixes gh-3841

Signed-off-by: Akhil CH <200716675+Akhil-1527@users.noreply.github.com>
